message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported vulnerability was verified as both within the last 24 hours and applicable to a component/version in the DLL-only scope.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-25 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-26 07:40 UTC (2026-10-25 13:10 IST through 2026-10-26 13:10 IST).

### Findings

No relevant new vulnerabilities were found.

A Microsoft .NET out-of-band update published on October 25 was reviewed. Its newly disclosed issues affect specific ASP.NET Core Linux tarballs and .NET runtime/NativeAOT packages; the official advisories do not identify the DLL/NuGet components and versions in this scan as affected, so the issues were excluded rather than loosely matched. Sources: [Microsoft .NET servicing notice](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/servicing/dotnet/net-10/2026/net-10-0-update-october-25-2026), [CVE-2026-111497 advisory](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/security/advisories/GHSA-p3jp-9v83-76w9), and [CVE-2026-114148 advisory](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/security/advisories/GHSA-r6pf-x897-gm86).

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The required dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations and libraries, MongoDB notices, CVE/NVD records, GitHub advisories, and CISA sources.

No new MongoDB ecosystem vulnerability was verified in the scan window. The latest authoritative MongoDB Server security release located was dated October 13, 2026, outside the window. Source: [MongoDB 9.0 release notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/9.0/).

### Review priority

No immediate vulnerability review is indicated from this scan. Continue routine monitoring; component applicability should be reassessed if deployment inventory includes unlisted .NET runtimes or ASP.NET Core Linux tarball installations.
